title: Whispering Whelk Waltzer
statement: A pearl-pink sea snail the size of a teacup, she hums soft bubbles and glides in slow waltz-turns across a floor of moon-pale sand, trailing a ribbon of glowing plankton behind her. Her tank is lit like late afternoon: amber light, drifting kelp, a tilted teapot she treats as her ballroom, and a few tiny shells that she circles as if they were guests.
